name: air_targetMin_degC
desc: coolest the vent is asked to hold
notes: the floor of the pair; never above the ceiling

name: air_targetMax_degC
desc: warmest before the vent opens

name: air_ventFullDem
desc: degrees over target at which the vent is wide

name: vent_redatum
desc: how far the ram re-datums past the stop
notes: the ram drives this far past shut to find its zero

name: run_liters
desc: litres the plant has passed
notes: retained: the cadence writes it, not every scan

name: vent_rawMin_mV
desc: actuator raw value fully shut

name: vent_rawMax_mV
desc: actuator raw value wide open

name: vent_engMin
desc: opening at the low end

name: vent_engMax
desc: opening at the high end

name: vent_min
desc: lowest believable opening
notes: under this the reading is not trusted

name: vent_max
desc: highest believable opening
notes: over this the reading is not trusted

name: air_ventStartDem
desc: degrees over target at which the vent starts

name: air_nightOfs_degC
desc: how much cooler the target runs at night

name: air_fanStartDem
desc: demand at which the fan starts

name: air_fanFullDem
desc: demand at which the fan is flat out

name: tank_soak_sec
desc: how long a fill is left to soak in

name: tank_lastFill
desc: uptime seconds at the last fill
notes: retained: a power cut must not lose the date

name: bus_dc_rawMin_mV
desc: rail raw value at zero volts

name: bus_dc_rawMax_mV
desc: rail raw value at full scale

name: bus_dc_engMin_V
desc: rail volts at the low end

name: bus_dc_engMax_V
desc: rail volts at the high end

name: bus_dc_min
desc: lowest believable rail volts
notes: under this: a dead sensor rather than a flat battery

name: bus_dc_max
desc: highest believable rail volts
